description: This file defines the AttachmentStore class which manages attachment-related operations such as download, recheck, rename, and delete within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for handling attachment streams, progress tracking, and integration with other stores and utilities.

classes.name: AttachmentStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore that manages attachment operations such as download, recheck, rename, and delete, with progress tracking and stream handling.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Increments the nonce to trigger a refresh of the store.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads multiple attachments as a ZIP stream, with progress updates and cancellation support.

methods.name: recheck
methods.description: Rechecks the validity of specified attachments, updating their status and showing error toasts if needed.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an attachment by updating its filename in the database and refreshing the store.

methods.name: permanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes an attachment, updates related notes and sessions, and handles errors.

methods.name: _changeWorkingStatus
methods.description: Updates the processing status of an attachment, indicating delete or recheck operations, or failure.
